Name: SMALLBASE_INVATION_NPC_PARAM_ST
Description: Night invaders (enemy versions of the heroes) that can appear at sites. The site lottery draws them by weight, never two of the same hero in one draw.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Set: the row is left out of the network test build. Retail: set on 3 rows.

Fields.Name: Character ID
Fields.Description: CharaInitParam of the invader. Its hero is used to avoid two invaders of the same hero in one draw.

Fields.Name: Lot Weight
Fields.Description: Weight of this invader in the draw for a site's invader slots (only the low 16 bits count). 0: never drawn (it can still be placed when named directly by a pattern). Retail: 100 on 9 of the 10 invaders.
